name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-seattle

tools.name: seattle_recent
tools.description: Recent records from a common Seattle open dataset (data.seattle.gov) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Seattle", "Seattle fire 911 calls", "Seattle business licenses", "Seattle code complaints". Names: crime, fire911, business, code_complaints. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use seattle_query.

dataset.description: One of: crime, fire911, business, code_complaints.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter, e.g. "offense='BURGLARY'". Omit for all recent rows.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: seattle_query
tools.description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Seattle open-data resource (data.seattle.gov) by its Socrata id (8-char like "tazs-3rd5"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use seattle_datasets to find a resource id, or seattle_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: seattle_datasets
tools.description: Search the Seattle open-data catalogue (data.seattle.gov) for datasets by keyword. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with seattle_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-seattle forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-seattle pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
